name: Erik Kristensen
bio:
Erik Kristensen's journey in motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's workshop. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he joined a small Danish racing team as a junior engineer. His sharp technical mind and knack for problem-solving quickly propelled him through the ranks. 

Over the years, Erik has honed his skills in both technical and managerial aspects of racing. He believes in fostering a collaborative and data-driven environment, where every team member's input is valued. His loyalty to his team is unwavering, and he strives to create a supportive atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Erik is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to make strategic decisions in the heat of the moment.

physical.description: Erik is a man of medium build with a weathered face that speaks of years spent trackside.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn-out notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee before every race.
